questions.stem: A grouped table has classes $0 \leq t < 5$ (freq $4$), $5 \leq t < 10$ (freq $6$), $10 \leq t < 15$ (freq $10$). What is the class interval that contains the median?
questions.explanation: Total frequency $= 20$. The median is between the $10$th and $11$th values. Cumulative: first class has $4$, first two classes have $10$, first three have $20$. The $10$th value is in the second class and the $11$th is in the third class. Since we need between them, and they span the boundary, the median class is $10 \leq t < 15$.

questions.stem: What is the modal class of the data: $0\text{–}10$ (freq $3$), $10\text{–}20$ (freq $8$), $20\text{–}30$ (freq $5$)?
questions.explanation: The modal class is the class with the highest frequency. $10\text{–}20$ has frequency $8$, which is the highest.
